{{Top}}
[[File:Rabbit.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Wim Magwit's green rabbit]]
The '''rabbit''' was a small furry mammal with long ears that was used in magic shows, particularly by the illusionist [[Wim Magwit]].<ref name="Boba Fett: Bounty on Bar-Kooda">''[[Boba Fett: Bounty on Bar-Kooda]]''</ref> Other entertainers were known to draw rabbits out of hats or [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] helmets.<ref>[[Player's Guide to Tapani|''Player's Guide to Tapani'']]</ref> There were [[Unidentified Endorian rabbit creature|rabbits on Endor]].<ref name="Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure">''[[Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure]]''</ref> Rabbits were said to have good eyesight due to eating [[Carrot/Legends|space carrots]].<ref name="SW9">[[Star Wars (1977) 9|''Star Wars'' (1977) 9]]</ref>

==Features==
Rabbits shared many physical and physiological similarities with [[Chickatili]] and [[Durni]]. A subspecies of rabbit included the [[Tumble Bunny]], a three-eared offshoot native to the forest [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].<ref name="HHH">{{Ewoks|Horville's Hut of Horrors (episode)}}</ref>

Sentient lagomorphs (rabbit-like species)<ref name="DarkForces">[[The Dark Forces Saga#The Dark Forces Saga, Part 1|''The Dark Forces Saga, Part 1'']]</ref> included the [[Bunny]],<ref name="DarkForces" /> [[Gerb]]<ref name="Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin">''[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin]]''</ref>, [[Hoojib/Legends|Hoojib]]<ref name="Star Wars 1977 55">[[Star Wars (1977) 55|''Star Wars'' (1977) 55]]</ref>, [[Kushiban]]<ref name="Junior Jedi Knights: The Golden Globe">''[[Junior Jedi Knights: The Golden Globe]]''</ref><ref name="Junior Jedi Knights: Anakin's Quest">''[[Junior Jedi Knights: Anakin's Quest]]''</ref>, and [[Lepi/Legends|Lepi]].<ref name="Star Wars 1977 8">[[Star Wars (1977) 8|''Star Wars'' (1977) 8]]</ref>

[[LEP servant droid/Legends|LEP servant droid]] were also known as "rabbit droids".<ref>{{SWArchive|url=kids/do/draw/f20090409/index.html|text=Drawing a Rabbit Droid}}</ref>
